image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a copper-colored metal chain lying diagonally across a light gray background. The chain consists of interlinked oval rings with a high-gloss, reflective finish. The foreground links are in sharp focus, showing clear metallic highlights and shadows, while the background links fade into a strong depth-of-field blur. There is faint, illegible text watermarking on the left side.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint, semi-transparent text resembling '...tain ...our...' is visible. It is illegible and likely an AI artifact or a degraded watermark, disrupting the clean background.

Extreme depth-of-field blur. While this can be a photographic technique, in AI generation it often masks structural inconsistencies in the receding links. It is noted as a potential artifact source but low severity as it mimics optical physics.

focus_areas: Link connectivity and closure (no fused rings)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the links in the mid-ground. AI often fails to maintain the 'over-under' weaving pattern of chains as they recede. Check if the text artifact is isolated or if there are other subtle texture smears in the background.
